test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six boys Sumit, Gopal, Honey, Ishaan, Jatin and Lalit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. Ishaan is the third to the left of Sumit. Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan. Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Honey?
solution:
**Given :** Six boys Sumit, Gopal, Honey, Ishaan, Jatin and Lalit are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. 

**Explanation :**

1) Ishaan is the third to the left of Sumit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f280eb5a17558404ae593e6cf101d3d22e5f3fa4aa00643f2fe621fd1d07092f.png] 

2) Jatin and Honey are the immediate neighbours of Ishaan.

3) Lalit is to the immediate right of Jatin.

After positioning Jatin, Honey and Lalit only one position is left which will be occupied by the only boy left i.e Gopal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88c063da33481993091a35684cbb97a3057c7dc4930248a9cfbaa5b30a4ff49b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Gopal is sitting to the immediate left of Honey.

Hence, **"Gopal"** is the correct answer.
